table_title: Daily and monthly discharge, in second-feet, 1928-29
site_name: NORTH FORK OF YUBA RIVER NEAR SIERRA CITY, CALIF.
location_text: Water-stage recorder in S. 1/2 sec. 29, T. 20 N., R. 12 E., 2 1/2 miles below mouth of South Fork of North Fork of Yuba River and 1 1/2 miles west of Sierra City.
notes: Sampled table is the daily grid (Oct.-Sept.); the monthly max/min/mean/run-off (acre-feet) block below it is the second table. Water year 1928-29 (October 1928 to September 1929). Many days are bracketed estimated means (footnote a Estimated). No county printed; no station number in this 1929 report.
